title: Source
description: A research source with stable identity. source_id = sha256(canonical_locator)[:16].

source_id.description: sha256(canonical_locator)[:16] — stable across edits and continuation

canonical_locator.description: Canonical identifier: doi:10.1038/..., arxiv:2305.14251, or normalized URL (lowercase scheme and host, no fragment or trailing slash, tracking params removed, remaining query params sorted by key and kept)

raw_url.description: Original URL as retrieved, before normalization

published_at.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the source was published or last updated; null when unknown

metadata_status.description: How far metadata has been verified

registered_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when source was registered (access date)

supersedes.description: Optional: source_id of the row this correction supersedes. Stores are append-only — a correction is a re-appended row naming the row it replaces.
